systems.note: Ca II K absorption at the galaxy redshift in the quasar spectrum
21-cm absorption feature at the galaxy redshift; maps neutral halo gas
Companion silhouetted against the galaxy's diffuse light; absorption of companion continuum places it behind the galaxy body

interpretation: Absorption at the galaxy redshift in a companion spectrum is a distance-ordering measurement: the absorber must lie between the observer and the emitter. Under TEP this is direct evidence that the two members occupy the same local volume rather than a projected coincidence.
